europe_now.title: Spain imposes border checks on Italian travellers amid migrant dispute
europe_now.summary: Spain has imposed border checks on Italian travellers amid a migrant dispute in Ceuta. The checks are intended to control migration flows across the EU border.

europe_now.title: Ukraine braces for winter power crisis after Russian strikes
europe_now.summary: Ukraine is preparing for a winter power crisis after Russian strikes damaged its energy infrastructure. The government warns that the attacks have reduced the number of operational thermal power plants.

top_stories.title: EU’s hidden food border inspectors get busier in an era of expanding trade
top_stories.summary: EU food border inspectors are handling more inspections as trade expands. The increased workload reflects growing concerns over food safety and compliance.
